content: Pydantic v2 field_validator uses @field_validator decorator with @classmethod. ValidationError is raised on model_validate() failure. NarrativeOutput.from_raw(raw_str) pattern: create class method that calls cls(text=raw.strip(), word_count=len(raw.split())). field_validator for 'text' checks non-empty and no error prefixes. field_validator for 'word_count' checks <= 250. On ValidationError in calling code: log warning and return fallback — do NOT re-raise (AI-06: never block delivery).
